text:
Anna: Quick thread — SDK error surface feels inconsistent and is tripping up customers. Example: py SDK raises ApiError('auth_failed') with no http_status, while js returns {status:401, message:'Unauthorized'}. This makes retry/auth guidance hard to follow.
Mohit: Yup saw a support ticket this morning where a customer retried on 401 repeatedly. Our middleware retries 5xx but docs aren't clear about auth vs transient.
Casey: Proposal idea: define a canonical error shape across SDKs: fields: `type` (enum), `code` (string), `http_status` (int), `message` (string), `details` (object). Keep language niceties (py subclasses) but always expose the canonical fields.
Julian: +1. For py we can keep ApiError subclasses for ergonomics but add `.type` and `.http_status` properties. For JS return a plain object + an Error subclass wrapper for thrown flows. Document mapping explicitly.
Anna: We should also update quickstart sample to show the recommended retry pattern:
```js
// handleErrors.js (quick example)
if (err.http_status >= 500) { retry() }
else if (err.http_status === 429) { backoff() }
else if (err.type && err.type.startsWith('auth')) { /* don't retry, surface to user */ }
else { throw err }
```
Call out: do not automatically retry on 401/403.
Mohit: One hitch — Dedicated/private sometimes return 400 for misconfigured keys (gateway quirk). We should prefer `type` as authoritative when gateway status codes are noisy.
Casey: Agreed. SDKs should translate gateway variants into canonical `type` values (e.g., gateway 400 -> type `invalid_auth` when header missing). That keeps client logic simple.
ci-bot: CI note: added an integration test to assert `error.code` + `http_status` are present on failure responses in SDK test matrix. See PR #3421.
Julian: :thumbsup: Can we add a small `handle-errors` snippet to the quickstart repo and link it from the SDK docs?
Anna: Action items: 1) Spec PR for canonical error shape (Casey) 2) Py SDK: add subclass + expose properties (Mohit) 3) JS SDK: ensure plain object + thrown wrapper + docs (Julian) 4) Update quickstart + support KB (Anna). I'll create tickets.
Mohit: I can pick up the py SDK changes and tests — ETA end of week.
Casey: I'll draft the spec by tomorrow morning and ping for review.
Julian: I'll add the quickstart snippet once the spec lands.
Anna: Thanks everyone. Logging this for DX backlog and linking to support cases. :sparkles:
